claim: The final framework keeps model fitting, validation decisions, and frozen-test evaluation separate.
transformation: Render locked train/validation/frozen-test roles and disjointness rules
limitation: Does not establish external real-farm validity.

claim: The validated representation uses a 2-s Log-Mel CRNN with four main and six subtype labels.
transformation: Render the validated 2-s Log-Mel CRNN and dual supervision heads
limitation: Does not claim a new backbone architecture.

claim: Class prototypes are built from training embeddings; calibration is validation-only.
transformation: Trace train-only prototype construction and validation-only calibration
limitation: Does not use test labels to construct or calibrate prototypes.

claim: B2 validation-selected Raw Softmax is primary; prototype routes are parallel candidates.
transformation: Separate B2 Raw Softmax primary evidence from parallel prototype candidates and B3 ablation
limitation: Does not establish an automatic routing policy.

claim: Two-second context supplies the major established clean-audio gain.
transformation: Plot run means with sample SD on a complete 0-1 Macro-F1 axis
limitation: Does not imply that the B2 or B3 increment is significant.

claim: The B2 and B3 increments are bounded by matched fold-seed and fold-cluster evidence.
transformation: Plot matched mean deltas with deterministic fold-cluster bootstrap intervals
limitation: Never call the B2 or B3 increment statistically significant.

claim: Lambda is selected independently within each fold from validation performance.
transformation: Plot only validation means and fold-wise selected lambdas
limitation: Does not use frozen-test performance for selection.

claim: Main and subtype ranking coverage quantifies candidate utility.
transformation: Compute main/subtype Rank-1 and Rank-2 coverage separately for all three routes
limitation: Coverage uses labels and is not a deployable score.

claim: Top-2 coverage quantifies feeding/stress boundary candidate retention.
transformation: Compute exact feeding/stress pair and true-class Top-2 coverage
limitation: Does not establish automatic boundary resolution.

claim: Hierarchy inconsistency enriches some method-specific error subsets.
transformation: Recompute main-versus-mapped-subtype inconsistency separately for all three methods
limitation: Does not establish a safe automatic rejector.

claim: Both prototype routes share the same main-prototype geometry while correctness partitions differ.
transformation: Show 25-run correct/error shared-margin distributions and error AUROC with fold-cluster CI
limitation: Does not invent a hierarchical or mapped-subtype cosine-distance vector.

claim: Seven unique frozen cases show complete Top-2 candidate evidence.
transformation: Apply the locked fold-0/seed-42 protocol and tabulate true class plus Softmax, main-prototype, and subtype Top-2 evidence
limitation: Cases are illustrative and do not estimate population prevalence.

claim: The same cases expose the complete shared main-prototype geometry.
transformation: Show distances from every case to all four main-class prototypes
limitation: Does not use true labels to define the displayed distances.

claim: The seventh case is the minimum remaining shared predicted-distance margin.
transformation: Show the label-free shared main-prototype predicted-distance margin
limitation: Does not call this a hierarchical decision distance.

claim: Every illustrative case is linked to a deterministic representative for the hierarchical-predicted main class.
transformation: Attach the closest same-run train-only representative of the hierarchical-predicted main class
limitation: Does not treat a representative as a biological exemplar.

claim: No retained clean alternative replaces the 2-s Log-Mel mainline.
transformation: Plot every locked clean ablation as mean plus sample SD without unmatched inference
limitation: Unmatched n=15 and n=25 rows do not establish significance.

claim: The fixed-lambda cohort provides a retrospective cumulative view.
transformation: Plot all 25 fixed-lambda retrospective stage trajectories and their mean
limitation: Does not supersede the validation-selected primary analysis.

claim: Fixed-lambda paired increments remain bounded retrospective evidence.
transformation: Plot fixed-lambda matched increments and stored bootstrap intervals
limitation: Does not make nonsignificant increments significant.

claim: All candidate weights are retained in the fold-wise selection audit.
transformation: Plot all candidate validation means and sample SD values
limitation: Does not use test metrics.

claim: Selected weights vary across folds under the locked rule.
transformation: Show the selected lambda for each fold
limitation: Does not define one globally optimal lambda.

claim: Best epochs document convergence of the frozen cohorts.
transformation: Summarise best epochs across matched fold-seed runs
limitation: Does not compare compute efficiency prospectively.

claim: Validation-test gaps disclose selection variability.
transformation: Summarise best-validation minus frozen-test gaps
limitation: Does not justify test-set tuning.

claim: Prototype behavior is evaluated under controlled additive noise.
transformation: Plot DEMAND environment-by-SNR descriptive means and sample SD
limitation: Does not establish real-farm external validity.

claim: TBUS results retain the complete fixed-lambda SNR series.
transformation: Plot TBUS environment-by-SNR descriptive means and sample SD
limitation: Does not establish real-farm external validity.

claim: STRAFFIC results retain the complete fixed-lambda SNR series.
transformation: Plot STRAFFIC environment-by-SNR descriptive means and sample SD
limitation: Does not establish real-farm external validity.

claim: The aggregate bounds average simulated-noise performance.
transformation: Plot the stored ALL_NOISY fixed-lambda=0.5 descriptive aggregate
limitation: Does not make repeated decisions independent recordings.

claim: AURC compares uncertainty ranking descriptively.
transformation: Plot stored ALL_NOISY AURC means
limitation: Does not show universal prototype uncertainty improvement.

claim: AUGRC reports selective-ranking quality relative to generalized risk.
transformation: Plot stored ALL_NOISY AUGRC means
limitation: Does not establish a deployment operating point.

claim: True-class margins diagnose prototype geometry after evaluation.
transformation: Plot true-class favorable-distance margins by correctness
limitation: This score is label-aware and is not deployable.

claim: Subtype true-class margins provide a bounded diagnostic comparison.
transformation: Plot subtype error AUROC from true-subtype favorable margins
limitation: This label-aware diagnostic is not a deployment claim.
